codelines.evidence: Opened src/services/contentstack.ts (lines 1-95). The Contentstack Stack is initialized at line 91 via `contentstack.Stack(options)` where `options` (lines 78-90) contains api_key, delivery_token, environment, branch, and fetchOptions — but NO `live_preview` block. Searched for `live_preview`, `preview_token`, `onEntryChange`, and `live-preview-utils` across the entire repo: all returned zero matches in source files (only orchestration log hits). The manifest lists `contentstack` and `@contentstack/utils` but NOT `@contentstack/live-preview-utils`. The codebase uses a `ContentstackFactory` class (line 109) with `createContentTypeQuery` and `createContentTypeEntryQuery` methods for data fetching, and components consume data via a `useContent` hook. Homepage is at src/components/pages/Homepage.tsx (renders ContentStackHomePageHeroBanner, HomepageComponentMapper, ContentstackRecentNews). Page service functions `getPageEntry` and `getSinglePageEntry` exist in src/services/pageService.ts. None of these are wired to any live-preview callback. The three integration points from the docs (live_preview config in Stack(), @contentstack/live-preview-utils init with onEntryChange, and page-level onEntryChange subscription) are all absent, confirming this work has not been started.

recommendedInvestigators.focus: Examine how the Contentstack Stack is configured in src/services/contentstack.ts, how the ContentstackFactory and its query methods feed data into page components, and how the useContent hook distributes content to Homepage and Discover Article page components. Determine where @contentstack/live-preview-utils init() and onEntryChange would integrate with the existing data-fetch flow (server-side vs client-side rendering, getStaticProps/getServerSideProps usage, and the useContent hook's reactivity model). Also check whether the app uses Next.js App Router or Pages Router, since the linked doc targets CSR App Router.
recommendedInvestigators.why: The Stack config at line 91 of contentstack.ts has no live_preview block, onEntryChange is absent everywhere, and @contentstack/live-preview-utils is not in the manifest. The data-fetch architecture (ContentstackFactory → getEntry/getSingleEntry → useContent hook) needs to be understood to determine how live-preview real-time updates would propagate to the Homepage and Discover Article pages.

recommendedWriters.focus: Must be able to: (1) add a live_preview config block (preview_token, enable, host) to the existing contentstack.Stack() options in src/services/contentstack.ts, introducing a new environment variable for the preview token; (2) install @contentstack/live-preview-utils, create an initialization module that calls ContentstackLivePreview.init() with stackSdk, ssr flag, and editButton config, and exports onEntryChange; (3) wire onEntryChange into the data-fetch paths for the Homepage and Discover Article pages so that draft entry changes trigger a re-fetch and re-render. Must understand Next.js routing model (Pages vs App Router), environment variable management, and the existing ContentstackFactory/useContent pattern to integrate without breaking existing SSR/SSG data flows.
recommendedWriters.why: All three integration points from the Contentstack Live Preview docs are absent: no live_preview in Stack config, no @contentstack/live-preview-utils package, and no onEntryChange subscription anywhere. This is the sole codeline in scope and all implementation work lands here.
